inputs: per-predicate frozen triplet logit and R50 continuous residual score
normalization: mean/populationstd on known training labels per predicate only;std floor0.001
fusion: two softplus nonnegative weights andbias perpredicate;18 nominal parameters;triplet_only zeros normalized R50 input (12 effective parameters)
loss: masked BCE +0.2 type-balanced known actor/predicate hinge margin1 +0.01 ridge onweights/bias
thresholds: same existing train-only >=90% precision and>=5accepted rule;no threshold fitting elsewhere
notes: Frozen source heads previously trained on GT crops of these training images; calibration/fusion is in-sample stacking, not out-of-fold evidence. Fit matched training detector views only. No hard R50 gate, hand labels/whitelists or dev-based hyperparameter selection. All evaluations reused development; no caption/novelty claim.
